newsitem.title: USA: Brent mostly stronger in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent mostly stronger in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude was mostly stronger in late U.S. paper dealings on Thursday, traders said.
Two full boats of June Brent changed hands at $18.47 a barrel, up five cents from the close of London's IPE.
Four partial cargoes changed hands at $18.40, $18.42, $18.43 and $18.44, traders said.
No intermonth spreads traded. May/June was talked at -20/-16 cents a barrel, June/July at -9/-7 cents and July/August at -10/-8 cents.
